text: Cash and checks are the payments most likely to go missing. A same-day deposit means every one is accounted for. Start with today's revenue.
Every check and cash payment goes into a deposit the same day.
To see what came in, click View payments.
Today's payments, by client, with the amount paid.
Click Close.
Click All payments for each payment on its own.
Here's the cash, the check and the card, with real money only.
Click Close.
Now the deposit. Click Create deposit.
Every cash and check payment not yet deposited is listed here.
Open the bank account list.
And choose Operating account.
And the date you take it to the bank.
Each cash and check payment, and who it was for.
Tick the cash.
And the check.
The slip lists each check, and the total should match what's in your hand.
Click Create deposit.
Scout posts the deposit and shows the slip.
Click Print deposit slip for the bank.
Then close it. The deposit is listed under Recent deposits, and the payments are gone from the undeposited list.
The most common mistakes are leaving checks in the car overnight, and leaving a cash payment out of the deposit. Remember: every check and cash payment goes into a deposit the same day.
